Scenario: User logs in with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open login page 2. Enter valid email/password 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to homepage; session created

Scenario: User logs in with invalid password
Steps: 1. Enter valid email, wrong password 2. Click Login
Expected Result: Error message shown; user stays on login page

Scenario: User searches for a product by name
Steps: 1. Type product name in search bar 2. Press Enter
Expected Result: Relevant results are returned, sorted by relevance

Scenario: User searches with special characters only
Steps: 1. Type '!!!@@@' 2. Search
Expected Result: No crash; 'No results found' shown gracefully

Scenario: Out-of-stock product shows correct state
Steps: 1. Open out-of-stock product page
Expected Result: 'Add to Cart' is disabled; 'Notify me' option shown instead

Scenario: User adds item to cart
Steps: 1. Open product page 2. Click Add to Cart
Expected Result: Cart icon count increases; item appears in cart summary

Scenario: User updates item quantity in cart
Steps: 1. Open cart 2. Increase quantity to 3
Expected Result: Line total and cart total recalculate correctly

Scenario: User tries to exceed available stock in cart
Steps: 1. Set quantity to 6 in cart
Expected Result: Quantity is capped at 5 with a stock-limit message

Scenario: User removes item from cart
Steps: 1. Click Remove on an item
Expected Result: Item removed; cart total updates; empty-cart state shown if last item

Scenario: Valid coupon code applies discount
Steps: 1. Enter coupon code at checkout 2. Apply
Expected Result: Discount is applied and reflected in the order total

Scenario: Expired coupon code is rejected
Steps: 1. Enter expired code 2. Apply
Expected Result: Error message: coupon expired; total remains unchanged

Scenario: User completes checkout with saved address
Steps: 1. Go to checkout 2. Select saved address 3. Confirm order
Expected Result: Order confirmation page shown with correct order summary

Scenario: Checkout blocks invalid payment details
Steps: 1. Enter invalid card number 2. Submit
Expected Result: Validation error shown; order is not placed

Scenario: User's cart becomes empty mid-checkout (item removed by admin)
Preconditions: Item removed from catalog during checkout
Steps: 1. Start checkout 2. Item goes out of stock server-side 3. Try to place order
Expected Result: User is shown a clear message and returned to cart instead of a broken order

Scenario: Order confirmation email is triggered
Steps: 1. Complete checkout successfully
Expected Result: Confirmation email is queued with correct order ID and items

Scenario: Payment gateway timeout is handled gracefully
Steps: 1. Submit payment 2. Gateway takes >30s to respond
Expected Result: User sees a retry/timeout message; order is not double-charged

Scenario: User views order status after placing an order
Steps: 1. Go to Order History 2. Open the order
Expected Result: Correct status (e.g. Processing) and item details are shown

Scenario: Order status updates as it moves through fulfillment
Steps: 1. Simulate status change to Shipped 2. Refresh order page
Expected Result: UI reflects updated status without requiring app reinstall/relogin

Scenario: Cart persists across web and mobile app for the same account
Preconditions: Same account logged in on both
Steps: 1. Add item on web 2. Open mobile app
Expected Result: Cart contents are synced across both platforms

Scenario: Product grid reflows correctly on small screens
Steps: 1. Open catalog page on a narrow viewport (375px)
Expected Result: Grid switches to single-column layout with no overlapping elements
